name: Video Explainer Tutorial
description: Turn knowledge points, operation steps or product usage methods into a segmented explainer tutorial video.

planning.planning_notes: Dynamically expand teaching segments from the steps or topic the user provides, with each segment corresponding to a picture and a video clip.
planning.prompt_guide: Accurate content, clear steps, and a one-to-one match between picture and narration; do not invent product features that were not provided.
conduct_rules: Dynamically decide the number of nodes and their dependencies from the user goal
Use only the capabilities declared in allowed_recipe_ids

The tutorial planning copy must be passed to every step image through prompt_for so that the images consume the upstream content; dependency_for only controls ordering and cannot replace content input
Generate and confirm the dynamic plan before creating canvas nodes

rating_bands.description: Fully meets the user goal and the workflow can be executed
Core flow is complete; a few non-critical adjustments are allowed
Missing key stages or incomplete dependencies

domain_constraints: The workflow must match the user goal and keep the input assets consistent
